Name: Othniel, Son of Kenaz
Summary: Othniel, son of Kenaz and Caleb's younger brother, captured Kirjath-sepher and married Achsah, and later became Israel's first judge.
KeyStory: Othniel took Kirjath-sepher and won Achsah as his wife; years later the Spirit of the LORD came on him and he delivered Israel from Cushan-rishathaim.
RelatedPeople: Caleb; Achsah, Daughter of Caleb; Kenaz
LifeLesson: The courage that takes one city can grow into the courage that delivers a nation.
